final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each line and detecting new entries by the timestamp, level, service, and message pattern. I filtered only ERROR and CRITICAL entries (case insensitive). For each entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC ISO format with Z suffix. I extracted the message after the service name on the first line. I collected traceback lines if present and extracted the last line of the traceback as the exception or null if none. I counted repeated messages from the lines "-- last message repeated N times --" following the entry and added that to the repeat_count. I aggregated counts by service summing the repeat_count values. Finally, I wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
